1.explanation:
1. packages/react/src/components/RadioButtonGroup/RadioButtonGroup.js – This core component renders only the fieldset, legend, and radio buttons. It has no props or rendering logic for invalid, warn, or helper text states (no CSS classes, icons, or text blocks). To implement the spec, it must accept new props (e.g. invalid, invalidText, warn, warnText, helperText) and render the corresponding UI below the fieldset.

2. packages/react/src/components/RadioButtonGroup/RadioButtonGroup-test.js – The existing tests only cover legend rendering, disabled, readOnly, and selection APIs. There are no tests for the new validation or helper states. We need to add tests verifying that supplying invalidText, warnText, and helperText props renders the correct icons, classes, and text nodes.

3. packages/react/src/components/RadioButton/RadioButton.stories.js – Although this file currently demonstrates basic and skeleton states, it needs examples (stories) for error, warning, and helper text variants at both the single-radio and group levels so designers and users can preview the new states in Storybook.
1.bug_scenario:
The spec images show how a RadioButton group should render validation and helper states in the white theme.  In addition to the standard unselected, selected, hover, focus, and disabled states, each radio button group must support:
- invalid state: red border + error icon + error text below
- warn state: yellow border + warning icon + warning text below
- help state: default border + info icon + helper text below
They also illustrate group‐level layouts: legend, vertical spacing, and wrapping of long messages.

Currently the implementation only handles selection, disabled, and readOnly. There is no support for any validation styling or display of error/warning/helper text or icons.
